youtube.title: Why Shoelaces Have Plastic Tips 👟 #Shorts
youtube.description:
The plastic or metal tip on a shoelace is called an aglet. A lace is made of many woven fibres that fray once cut; the aglet binds them tight and stiffens the end so it threads easily through eyelets. Next time you lace up your shoes, check the tip.
